name: Human writing quality
measures: How natural and specific the writing reads: plain vocabulary, varied rhythm, few hedges and template constructions, no invisible characters, consistent with the creator's banned-word list.
limitations: These are local heuristics modelled on common signals of generated text. They are not an AI detector and do not call one.
A high score does not mean any detector will classify the text as human, and nothing here can guarantee that.
Human writers trip these checks too; the goal is better writing, not evasion.
Rhythm and diversity need roughly 40+ words to be meaningful.

criteria.label: Plain vocabulary
criteria.measures: Few stock / slop terms and template constructions.

rules.fix: Swap each flagged term for the plain word or the concrete thing.

rules.why: Template constructions ('not just X, but Y', 'here's the thing').

criteria.label: Rhythm
criteria.measures: Sentence length varies; sentences don't all start the same way.

rules.fix: Add one very short sentence and one longer one.

rules.why: Share of sentences starting with the same word.

criteria.label: Punctuation habits
criteria.measures: Few em dashes and stacked triads.

rules.why: Em/en dashes between clauses are a strong generated-text habit.
rules.fix: Use a full stop or a comma.

rules.why: 'X, Y and Z' lists over and over.
Words the creator listed as never-use.
rules.fix: Replace with the creator's own phrasing.

dealbreakers.message: Invisible / format characters present. Run rewrite_check.py clean.
Five or more slop terms per 100 words. Rewrite, do not patch.
2.5+ slop terms per 100 words. Reads generated.
Uses a word the creator never uses.
